examples.arabic: انا هكمل مشي معاها عشان انا جعان
examples.english: I will continue walking with her because I am hungry.
examples.transliteration: ana hakammel mashy maaha ashan ana gaan

examples.english: My brother is hungry and waiting.

examples.arabic: عمر عنده تلاتين سنة وبيشتغل ميكانيكي في الدقي، وهو دايما جعان.
examples.english: Omar is thirty years old and works as a mechanic in Dokki, and he is always hungry.
examples.transliteration: Omar ando talateen sana wa biyishtaghal meekaneekee fee El Dokki, wa howa dayman gaaan.

examples.arabic: قولتله انا جعان انا هعمل اكل
examples.english: I told him I am hungry, I will cook food.
examples.transliteration: Oltelo ana gaaan ana haamel akl.

examples.arabic: كنت جعان جدا بس مفيش اكل سهل في البيت
examples.english: I was very hungry but there was no easy food at home
examples.transliteration: Kunt gaaan giddan bas mafish akl sahl fil beit

examples.arabic: أنا جعان اوي ولما بشوف عيلتي مبسوطة كده أنا بكون مبسوط جدا
examples.english: I am very hungry, and when I see my family happy like this, I get very happy.
examples.transliteration: Ana gaaan awi w lama bashoof 3eilti mabsoota keda ana bakoon mabsoot giddan
